threshold_rule.owner_rule: Five independently observed, evidence-backed instances of the same commercially relevant problem are sufficient to form a candidate cluster.

problem.title: Manual group/private/special booking friction
problem.definition: The venue offers online or public visitor information, but higher-value group, private, school, guided, or special booking journeys require phone/email/manual enquiry instead of a clear self-service digital booking or qualification flow.
problem.commercial_relevance: Manual high-value booking flows create avoidable lead friction, staff handling, response-delay risk and incomplete enquiry data. The problem is bounded and can be improved without replacing the venue's core ticketing system.

evidence_instances.name: Dublin Zoo
evidence_instances.observation: The official ticket page supports online individual/family ticketing, but group tickets are explicitly not available online and users are directed to phone/contact for pre-booking.

evidence_instances.name: Cork City Gaol
evidence_instances.observation: The official group-booking page requires advance group booking through phone/email/contact rather than a complete self-service group booking checkout.

evidence_instances.name: National Botanic Gardens of Ireland
evidence_instances.observation: Public tours can be handled through Eventbrite, but group bookings are directed to the Visitor Centre by email/phone.

evidence_instances.name: Dubai Dolphinarium
evidence_instances.observation: Standard experiences can be booked online, but private sessions require advance phone contact and the page exposes a manual enquiry form for session details.

evidence_instances.name: The Everyman
evidence_instances.observation: Standard show tickets are bookable online, while group bookings are directed to a dedicated phone number/email and handled as enquiries/reservations.

sample.note: This is a targeted cluster proof, not an estimate of prevalence across the full 1,200-node tranche.

bounded_deliverable: mobile-first group/private booking or enquiry microflow
optional deposit/payment-link or existing ticketing handoff
amx_solution.non_goal: Do not replace the customer's existing core ticketing platform unless separately scoped.

dependencies.payment_integration: OPTIONAL; CUSTOMER PAYMENT RAIL/API REQUIRED IF INCLUDED

effort.pilot_scope: single branded microflow + structured lead routing + handoff
effort.pricing_state: NOT_YET_EVIDENCE_PRICED; PRI MAY TEST A SMALL FIXED-PRICE PILOT

falsifier_or_kill_condition: Kill or weaken the cluster if outreach shows venues intentionally prefer manual high-touch group sales and do not value a structured digital qualification/booking layer, or if their existing systems already provide an equivalent hidden workflow.
next_action: Persist/read back this cluster as Stage-2 evidence, then hand the bounded offer and these five evidenced prospects to PRI for a limited market test if Stage-2 acceptance passes.
